_doc: Non-crypto fixtures the in-process differential oracle cannot execute for a STRUCTURAL reason (not a missing crypto witness). Each has a specific, verifiable cause and is covered by a more appropriate oracle. The three causes: (1) STATEFUL — a StatefulSmartContract auto-injects checkPreimage at method entry and a state-continuation output at exit; a valid spend needs a tx-context BIP-143 sighash preimage + serialised outputs on the unlocking stack, which the tx-less TS ScriptVM cannot synthesise (empirically: the interpreter accepts but the VM fails on OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY / stack-underflow). These are executed with real tx context by conformance/script_execution_test.go (executeScriptWithTx) — Phase 1's gated Script Execution Oracle. (2) GO-ONLY — the fixture carries compilers:[go]; the TypeScript tier ships no Stack-IR codegen for it, so compile() cannot produce deployed bytes. (3) INTERPRETER-UNSUPPORTED — the ANF interpreter (the oracle's source-semantics engine) does not model the raw-script intrinsic the contract uses. See conformance/witnesses/README.md.
